basedOn.relation: Predecessor REJECTED (CLAUDE-PPBS-V1-B1, CLAUDE-PPBS-V1-B2, PPBSV1-B1, PPBSV1-S1). This successor lands those findings.

authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the preview-scoped DR-117 successor candidate authorized by D-132 / file 12 §5. It is not a second register row. It does not SATISFY DR-117. It does not treat product-boundary-successor-contract.v8 or product-boundary-preview.v2 as SATISFIED. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Disposition the seven file-02 product-boundary items as they apply to the D-002 architecture preview, with a preview-scoped enforcement-evidence limb, without silent succession from preview.v2 and without replacing v8's leftover T2-02 role.

productBoundarySuccessorV8.role: Remains DR-117's leftover T2-02 candidate for general succession. Its purpose includes refusing silent succession from preview. This artifact does not replace, apply, or succeed v8.

productBoundaryPreviewV2.role: Remains the architecture-preview owner recording of the seven items for DR-010 / condition 1. D-068 states it does not close DR-117. This artifact is not a restatement of preview.v2 as DR-117 SATISFIED.

lineage.relation: Preview-scoped complement. v8 stays the leftover T2-02 candidate. preview.v2 stays the condition-1 owner recording. This artifact is a new independently reviewed preview-scoped successor *candidate* authorized by D-132 (not silent succession from preview.v2). File 12 has no authority and is cited only as the recorded goal D-132 named.
lineage.previewReadAs: These seven dispositions plus the enforcement-evidence classes are the proposed preview-scoped successor candidate. They do not effect SATISFIED. They do not convert preview.v2 into succession. They do not replace v8.

registerRowQuoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-117 |'.
registerRowQuoted.acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim: Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence

sevenItems.countPin: D-011, seven items. Any change to that enumeration re-opens DR-117.

dispositions.name: marketplace/catalog and governance depth
dispositions.preview: NO. First-party / explicitly trusted components only. No marketplace.

dispositions.name: external lifecycle parity and discovery
dispositions.preview: NO public lifecycle parity. Host-owned one lifecycle for first-party components.

dispositions.name: contribution roles beyond narrow/data-only
dispositions.preview: NO. P-2 narrow producers / data-only remains. Findings stay host-owned (DR-133 / D-136 candidate).

dispositions.name: untrusted native or WASM admission and required enforcement evidence
dispositions.preview: NO admission. DR-128 stays post-MVP. Fault containment (DR-G21) is not a sandbox and is not this item's enforcement evidence. Required OS/WASM enforcement, permission/platform matrix, escape tests, revocation, and incident ownership attach to DR-128's post-MVP successor, not to condition 4. Preview enforcement is the excluded-form admission refusal (enforcementEvidence.EE-4), not a sandbox demonstration.

dispositions.name: imperative contributions, probes, project hooks, and root commands
dispositions.preview: NO as contribution roles. Imperative contributions, contribution-owned probes, project hooks, and contributor-owned root commands remain excluded. Host-owned consented doctor probes remain host acts under D-002 / D-032 and are not contribution-granted probes. No contributor owns a root command. Analyze stays offline.

dispositions.name: network-granted analysis and egress defaults
dispositions.preview: NO. Offline preview. No network-granted analysis default.

dispositions.name: replacement of the full-default G3 physical substrate
dispositions.preview: PARTIAL, recorded: TypeScript is the only preview language role. Default useful install is signed distribution core + semantic host + one selected TypeScript closure + the future DR-131 pack (pack identity not invented here). Core-only is recovery/management, not the analysis product. The rustc_driver sidecar remains the substrate and is deferred as a supported analysis role, not abandoned. D-002 independent-release surface is preserved, not narrowed.

enforcementEvidence.cellAnswer: Preview enforcement evidence is excluded-form admission refusal plus the per-item classes below. Demonstrated OS/WASM confinement is DR-128, not this preview candidate and not condition 4.

v1SlicePin.verbatim: A `PlanIntent` containing an excluded form is rejected during request validation with the required typed outcome and creates no `ExecutionId`, `AttemptRecord`, `ExecutionPlan`, or authoritative Run; a substitution after admission is also rejected before any stage executes.

classes.invariant: No marketplace, public catalog, or ecosystem governance surface is admitted. Only first-party / explicitly trusted components.
classes.negativeClass: An authenticated manifest from an unapproved external publisher is refused at admission. No ExecutionId is created.
classes.owner: host admission / DR-104 leftover-integration. No DR-G owns a marketplace because the surface is excluded.
classes.laterExecution: Named remaining design if no existing harness specifies the unapproved-publisher refusal. Not silently called condition 4.

classes.invariant: No public lifecycle parity or external discovery service.
classes.negativeClass: A request that requires an external discovery/lifecycle endpoint is refused as an excluded form under v1-slice §7 item 8.
classes.laterExecution: Named remaining design until a harness is recorded. Not condition 4 by default.

classes.invariant: Contributors remain P-2 narrow/data-only. They do not own policy, persistence, rendering, termination, or host lifecycle. Findings remain host-owned (DR-133).
classes.negativeClass: A first-party or contributor manifest claiming policy, persistence, rendering, termination, or host-lifecycle authority is refused at admission.
classes.laterExecution: DR-133 retained classes stay specified-not-executed. No SATISFIED.

classes.invariant: Untrusted native or WASM is not admitted in the preview. DR-G21 is not a sandbox.
classes.negativeClass: A PlanIntent or manifest requesting untrusted native/WASM admission is an excluded form: rejected in request validation; no ExecutionId / AttemptRecord / ExecutionPlan / authoritative Run (v1-slice §7 item 8). A substitution after admission is rejected before any stage executes.
classes.owner: host admission. Demonstrated OS/WASM enforcement, matrix, escape tests, revocation, incident ownership: DR-128 post-MVP, not condition 4.
classes.laterExecution: Preview class specified here, unexecuted. DR-128 remainder stays leftover-design on that row.

classes.invariant: Contribution-owned imperative, probes, project hooks, and root commands are excluded. Host-owned consented doctor probes remain host acts (D-002 / D-032).
classes.negativeClass: A component manifest claiming a project hook, root command, or contribution-granted probe is refused at admission. A test that removes host-owned doctor consented probes is not required by this exclusion.
classes.laterExecution: Named remaining design until a harness is recorded for the manifest-refusal class.

classes.invariant: Analyze is offline. No network-granted analysis default. No undeclared egress.
classes.negativeClass: A PlanIntent requesting network-granted analysis, or a component/host-broker undeclared egress path during analyze, is refused / excluded-form. No coherent Run is fabricated from partial network output.
classes.owner: DR-G01..G05 / offline CLI-baseline leftover measurement (DR-123 SATISFIED leftover). This artifact does not re-qualify those gates.
classes.laterExecution: Existing offline/egress measurement remains condition 4 / DR-G01..G05. Not QUALIFIED here.

classes.invariant: Default useful install = signed distribution core + semantic host + one selected TypeScript closure + future DR-131 pack. Core-only is not the analysis product. TypeScript-only preview role. rustc_driver sidecar deferred, not abandoned. Independent-release surface preserved (no lockstep of the selected closure to the core release).
classes.negativeClass: A release that (a) treats core-only as the analysis product, (b) admits a second preview language role, (c) abandons the sidecar, or (d) locksteps the TypeScript closure to the core release, fails this class.
classes.owner: DR-119 leftover TypeScript-role closure (DR-G14) and D-002 independent-release. Pack identity remains DR-131.
classes.laterExecution: DR-G14 leftover measurement remains condition 4. Pack selection remains DR-131 (no pack invented here).

doesNot: Does not open D-056 Class A.
Does not invent the DR-131 pack.
Does not convert product-boundary-preview.v2 into DR-117 SATISFIED.
Does not treat DR-G21 as a sandbox.
